sonnet.problem: This story card only repeats card 1 (sword as razor, head and beard) and adds a joke. It carries no new part of the passage forward.
sonnet.rule: Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.

sonnet.problem: The card mostly recaps the strands and the fire from cards 9 and 10, then only points ahead to the next verse. It also adds 'one little flame', which the text doesn't say.

The blank asks the baker to supply the final word of verse 17 ('childless'). Nothing on the earlier cards lets the baker reason to it over 'homeless' or 'leaderless', so it comes down to guessing wording they haven't seen.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
